taskVersion.name: ves-heldout-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station H-07 (survey area H). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1790.5 | 0.52 | 0.52
2 | 384.0 | 1.63 | 2.15
3 | 73.0 | 22.70 | 24.85
4 | 103.4 | 11.48 | 36.33
5 | 540.2 | 1.37 | 37.70
6 | 520.8 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: H-07
Curve type: HK-type (ρ1 > ρ2 > ρ3 < ρ4 < ρ5 > ρ6)
Aquifer depth: 2.15 m – 36.33 m (low-to-moderate resistivity zone, layers 3–4)
Recommendation: Case off the resistive near-surface layers (0–2.15 m) and drill through to approximately 36 m to fully penetrate the conductive weathered/fractured zone (73–103 Ω·m); position well screens within this interval to maximize water yield, and confirm basement/competent rock contact near 37.7 m before terminating the hole.
